title: Leaky Capture
summary: Someone reached the backup area of a file server. All you have is a short network capture.
objectives: Open the capture in an analysis tool
Recover the password of the login that worked
learningOutcomes: Read HTTP traffic from a packet capture
Explain why Basic authentication needs TLS
Separate failed attempts from the successful one

references.label: CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

hints.bodyMd: In Wireshark, try the display filter `http` and read the requests in order.
Several logins fail. Find the response with status 200, then read the `Authorization` header of the request before it.
